# bioexcel/biobb_haddock/haddock3_accessibility

## Summary

Wrapper class for the Haddock-Restraints Accessibility module.

Haddock-Restraints Accessibility computes residues accessibility using freesasa included in the Haddock3 package.

Nextflow adapter of the [Accessibility](https://biobb-haddock.readthedocs.io/en/latest/haddock_restraints.html#module-haddock_restraints.haddock3_accessibility) building block of [biobb_haddock](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_haddock) 5.3.1.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_HADDOCK_HADDOCK3_ACCESSIBILITY } from 'bioexcel/biobb_haddock/haddock3_accessibility'

workflow {
    BIOBB_HADDOCK_HADDOCK3_ACCESSIBILITY(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_pdb_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the input PDB file |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_accessibility_path` | yes | txt, dat, out | Path to the output file with accessibility information |
| `output_actpass_path` | no, opt-in | txt, dat, out | Path to the output file with active/passive residues to be used as haddock3 restraint information |
| `versions_biobb_haddock` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_haddock', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Accessibility properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_actpass_path: 'txt']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_haddock container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_HADDOCK_HADDOCK3_ACCESSIBILITY' {
        ext.properties = [chain: 'A']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chain` | string | "A" | Chain to be used from the input PDB file. |
| `cutoff` | number | 0.4 | Relative cutoff for sidechain accessibility. |
| `probe_radius` | number | 1.4 | Probe radius for the accessibility calculation. |
| `pass_to_act` | boolean | false | If True, the passive residues become active in the actpass file and vice versa. |
| `binary_path` | string | "haddock" | Path to the haddock haddock executable binary. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
